definitions.explanation: A calendar where one page is torn off each day to reveal the next date. Often features daily quotes, trivia, or seasonal information. Short for 日めくりカレンダー.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧{日|ひ}めくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくる。
examples.english: I tear off a page of the daily calendar every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日|ひ}めくり⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: There is a tear-off calendar hanging at my grandmother's house.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{日|ひ}めくり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{載|の}っていて→載る：27882_noru⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: This daily calendar features one four-character idiom each day, which is educational.

notes:
{日|ひ}めくり is a daily tear-off calendar where one page is removed each day. Short for {日|ひ}めくり⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧.

FORMS:
⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (day) + めくる (to turn over, tear off)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日|ひ}めくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧めくる: to tear off a page of the daily calendar
- {日|ひ}めくり⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧: daily tear-off calendar (full form)
- {日|ひ}めくり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to hang a daily calendar

POPULAR TYPES:
- ⟦{名言|めいげん}→名言：20185_meigen⟧{日|ひ}めくり: daily famous quotes
- ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧{日|ひ}めくり: daily four-character idioms
- ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧{日|ひ}めくり: traditional calendar with seasonal information
- ⟦{俳句|はいく}→俳句：00083_haiku⟧{日|ひ}めくり: daily haiku

CULTURAL NOTE:
Still common in Japanese homes, offices, and temples, especially among older generations. Tearing off the page each morning is a small daily ritual that marks the passage of time.
